newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends up as paper floods market.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends up as paper floods market.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed up 150 basis points at 18 percent on Thursday on what dealers said was a late glut of paper.
"Players who had hung on to paper had to sell it at whatever rate they could get at the close, and so rates surged," a dealer said.
Rates earlier reached as low as 16.00 percent in line with a strong peso and low U.S. long-bond yields, dealers said.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts ended 1.4 centavos firmer at 7.7620/7.7650 per dollar, while the U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was up 31/32 to yield 6.55 percent in late trade.
